label: early-episode a1 trials without a just-seen reward
explanation: Fires only early in the episode: about 21% of steps in trials 0-9, 10% in 10-19, 4% in 20-29, and never from trial 40 on. So its threshold rides on a slow drift in the hidden state. Within that window it fires on trials where the agent chooses a1 (92% of the mass; it is almost silent on a2 trials and on S2 at D2) and is silenced by a reward input (in_rew==1 steps hold 0.2% of the mass). Within a trial it builds from D1 to GO to D2, peaking at D2 after a1 to S1 common, and it is strongest after one or more unrewarded a1 trials. Also elevated when start_high=1 / good=S1. action is the agent own upcoming choice at D1/GO (FUTURE but agent-computed); a fully observed variant (prev_action at D1, action at GO, in_state==S1 at D2) scored about the same (F1 0.39 vs 0.39 at ep_trial<30). Precision is low because the episode-time decay is graded and a hard cutoff cannot capture it. Recorded predicate: dev F1 0.47, mass recall 0.81.
